text:
maria: Heads-up — planning RBAC tightening for on-prem control planes next Wed. Need to validate audit logs capture KMS decrypt/unseal and network policies lock down egress to only vault proxies. Who can validate telemetry & incident playbook?

Derek: I can run KMS log check. Which KMS are we validating? HSM-backed Vault in eu-prod? Also need to confirm: do we log key wrap/unwrap ops? Some HSM vendors only log admin API calls.

alex: Yes HSM-backed Vault in eu-prod. Action items: enable Vault audit devices on each node, ensure JSON log_format, and tag requests with X-Request-ID for tracing. Quick example to enable file audit device: 

```
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log
# ensure log_format=json in /etc/vault/config.hcl
```

Also make sure the KMS client library sets a per-request trace id so logs correlate with API traces.

sara: Minimal NetworkPolicy idea to limit sealed-node egress to only Vault proxy and the k8s-api server (keeps blast radius small):

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: sealed-pod-egress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sealed-node
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: vault-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.1/32 # k8s API (example)
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 6443
```

maria: Good. Also need to confirm audit retention + binary-proof shipping for forensic evidence: ship vault_audit.log to encrypted S3 with server-side immutability (WORM) and mirror to SIEM. If KMS becomes unavailable during rollout, incident playbook: 1) fail-closed for tenant unseal (no silent fallback), 2) promote read-only fallback using pre-wrapped offline keys stored in secure-archive (eviction-safe), 3) page SRE and exec incident bridge. Any objections to fail-closed?

Derek: Fail-closed is safest for data separation. We do have pre-wrapped offline keys in secure-archive but they are untested in a live failover. Recommend a dry-run in canary. Also suggest reducing runtime key cache TTL to minimize exposure: set REDWOOD_KEY_CACHE_TTL=30 (seconds) in sealed runtime image.

jen: RBAC change timeline proposal: canary 10% clusters Wed AM, audit feed validation Thurs, full rollout Fri. I will update the change request with test checklist. @maria please confirm rollback criteria (audit events missing, auth errors, traffic anomalies).

maria: Rollback if any tenant decrypt failures >0 for 15 continuous minutes OR missing unseal audit events for 5m in the SIEM. Preflight script to run before canary: 

```
# preflight: check audit device + netpol
kubectl logs -l app=vault --tail=200 | jq '.request_id, .auth' | grep unseal || echo "no unseal logs"
kubectl get networkpolicy sealed-pod-egress -o yaml
# validate audit shipper
curl -sS https://siem.local/api/health | jq '.last_received["vault_audit"]'
```

sara: I'll run preflight tomorrow 08:00 and post results here. Will also run a synthetic decrypt/unseal and confirm audit shows a matching request_id. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Alert configured — will notify #incidents if vault_audit events stop shipping for >5m or if audit size drops by >90%/hour.

maria: Thanks team — we'll sync 10:30am tomorrow to walk the runbook and confirm ownership. :eyes:
